title: Floating white foundation
prompt:

Input image 1 is the exact material reference: DSCF2954, the photographed ONENESS family statue. Study its particular naturally warm ivory limestone, visibly irregular vertical chisel scars, worn chalky faces, weathered edges and gray recesses. Transfer this same photographed stone character faithfully to the requested wordmark, not a different material.
Text MUST read exactly once: ASTIR, spelled A S T I R, five letters only.
Visual: straight-on frontal view, thin dimensional carving, elegant premium proportions, composed with generous side margins. Whole word fully visible, no clipping. Wide 3:1 landscape canvas. Use a plain UNIFORM warm off-white backdrop, no horizon line, no textured background, no checkerboard. Realistic directional studio illumination gently reveals the source stone texture. No photograph scenery. No extra words, ONENESS plaque, captions, numbers, watermarks, diagrams, UI, buttons, mockups, pages or typography samples. No rounded inflatable clay, no plastic, no glossy finish, no balloon forms, no chunky playful letters.
Specific study: The FIRST letter A must be replaced by the ORIGINAL FAMILY SCULPTURE from image 1, without its pedestal: retain the source's two distinct irregular adult heads leaning together, the small child at center-left, the embracing curved arms, both central voids and the angular, craggy, asymmetrical natural stone. Do not simplify it into rounded smooth clay. Subtly taper its outer bodies toward the heads so it serves as the first A. To its immediate right carve ONLY S T I R, four slim premium uppercase letters, in the identical rough ivory stone with matching grain and self-shading. The family A plus STIR must read as the single exact word ASTIR. DO NOT add another typographic A. Match the height of STIR to the family head height. Keep the family sculptural anatomy recognizable and the other four letters deliberately slimmer and sleek. Add ONE detached, continuous, long rectangular WHITE LIMESTONE base underneath the ENTIRE word, spanning continuously from the family's leftmost foot to beyond the R. This is a single long plinth without divisions. It has the same visibly chipped source stone texture. There must be a CLEAR NARROW AIR GAP of roughly 6% of capital letter height between the bottom of EVERY letter including the family and the flat top of the plinth, so ALL five letter positions visibly hover. Nothing bridges that gap. Use sleek slightly condensed sans serif S T I R. No inscription or plaque on the base. Pale naturally white/ivory stone throughout, warm off-white uniform backdrop.
caption: The family A and slim stone letters float above a continuous white plinth.
geometry: Original family geometry used as the A, taller than sans STIR. A retains its closed lower opening. All upper elements separated from one continuous ivory stone base by a clear air gap; no supports.
refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the exact EDIT TARGET. Remove ALL support pegs, ALL stems, ALL little pillars, and ALL connectors. The word must float freely unsupported above the base as a surreal logo composition; this deliberate physically impossible hovering is essential. The ENTIRE horizontal 30-pixel slit should show the existing off-white background uninterrupted, from the leftmost foot of family A across to the far side of R. Keep the base exactly as in source, ivory pale stone and continuous.
